eventMetadata.context_description: **Marine layer and onshore flow are capping highs at official Los Angeles stations today.** National Weather Service guidance and recent model runs point to a peak temperature in the 70–73°F range at primary reporting sites such as downtown Los Angeles or KLAX, consistent with the market’s heavy weighting on the 70–71°F (55%) and 72–73°F (32.5%) brackets. Persistent June gloom—low stratus and a strong sea breeze—has kept coastal Southern California from reaching the mid-70s or higher despite a developing El Niño that favors modestly above-normal seasonal temperatures. Yesterday’s observed high near 77°F and today’s forecast showing only gradual afternoon clearing support the current trader consensus rather than a warmer outcome. Resolution will hinge on the final National Weather Service climatological report, with little chance of significant revision before sunset.
